# HR operations review - 8 June 2026, seminar room 4B

Attendees: Priya Raghavan, Tomas Lindqvist, Mei-Lin Chao, Doug Whitmore (chair)

The panel reviewed the spring recruitment numbers and the payroll migration plan, then fixed the scope of the July policy refresh.

Decisions
- The payroll migration moves to cutover on 18 July.
- The intern cohort starts with a shorter first-week schedule.

Action items
- Priya Raghavan to renew the employee assistance program contract before 30 June 2026.
- Tomas Lindqvist to circulate the revised travel claim form by 12 June 2026.
- Mei-Lin Chao to book the benefits fair venue for 24 September 2026.

Next review: 13 July 2026, seminar room 4B.

tasks/ folder holds the running to-do list for the group.

For the September office move see office-relocation-faq.md.

# Office relocation FAQ (September 2026)

Q: When do desks move?
A: Building 2 floors move on 5 September; building 3 follows on 12 September.

Q: Can I box my own monitors?
A: No, facilities packs and transports all monitors; raise a ticket.

Q: Where do visitors check in during the move?
A: Temporary reception is in the building 1 lobby until 30 September.
